headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.8
summary: The filter sheet keeps its Browse-by list no matter what: the content types are always there, and categories and versions fill in on their own once the network answers.

items.text: The filter panel now always lists Addons, Maps, Texture Packs, Scripts and Skins instead of sometimes showing only the All row when the category list had not loaded yet.
Opened filter panels refresh themselves when categories or game versions finish loading, keeping whatever you already picked.
